name: Teysa Karlov
aliases: Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov
description: Teysa Karlov is the Matriarch of the Karlov family and an Orzhov Syndicate leader on Ravnica, an advokist who wields law-magic and became guildmaster.

bio.text: Her coup with Tajic against the Obzedat was foiled by her ghostly grandfather, and the Ghost Council stripped her of her offices.

bio.text: She hosted the gala at Karlov Manor where Zegana was murdered, and Kaya then found Teysa dead in her parlor, stabbed with her own cane beside a note in Phyrexian script.

timeline.summary: After the Guildpact is broken, Teysa Karlov drafts a new non-magical document for cooperation.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov of the Orzhov Syndicate drafted a new, non-magical document amongst the guilds

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As baroness of the Utvara Reclamation Zone, Teysa helps stop Zomaj Hauc's schemes with an assembled force and a controlled dragon.
timeline.quote: she was influential in stopping Hauc

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Advokist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa mocks the Gruul for following Borborygmos.
timeline.quote: the only orders he gives are 'Crush them!' and 'We eat!'

citation.text: Borborygmos (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Gruul ravage the streets while Teysa leads the Orzhov Syndicate to cleanse them.
timeline.quote: Teysa leads the Orzhov Syndicate to "cleanse" them.

citation.text: "Guildpact", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Uncle makes Teysa baroness of Utvara and they travel there by lokopede with Melisk and Crix.
timeline.quote: makes his cousin Teysa Karlov the baroness of Utvara

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa and Melisk bring Uncle's corpse into Pivlic's bar where Kos works.
timeline.quote: carrying the corpse of Uncle, who was killed during the Gruul attack.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa hires Aradoz and charges Dr. Nebun with curing the Kuga plague.
timeline.quote: She charges him with making a cure for the Kuga plague

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Uncle becomes a ghost, joins the Obzedat and watches Teysa through a mirror.
timeline.quote: He now is a ghost and has joined the Obzedat

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa sends Pivlic, Kos and the Grugg Brothers to rescue Crix; Nebun reveals he always had a cure and Teysa buys it.
timeline.quote: Nebun reveals that he had a cure for the Kuga all along.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa discovers Melisk has been erasing her memory and that Uncle's death and the deal with Niv-Mizzet were Obzedat schemes; she breaks her oath.
timeline.quote: Teysa's memory is returned.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa rallies Utvara against the Cauldron and takes control of the Taj, who murder Melisk.
timeline.quote: They murder Melisk and join Teysa's army.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa breaks into the Cauldron and has Pivlic administer cures so the dragons cannot breathe.
timeline.quote: the dragons can't breathe normal air, only Kuga-infected air.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A dragon awakens and Hauc commands it; Teysa reads Crix's spell to command the last dragon.
timeline.quote: making the final dragon hers to command.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a dogfight Hauc dies; the two dragons kill each other.
timeline.quote: The two dragons kill each other

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather is brought before the Azorius and Teysa recognizes her as the client who wants her as Advokist.
timeline.quote: When she reaches the cell, she recognizes her client as the angel known as Feather .

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Dissension Teysa helps draft a new non-magical Guildpact and becomes the first Grand Envoy of the Orzhov.
timeline.quote: has been made the first and only Grand Envoy of the Orzhov Syndicate

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Grand envoy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa warns Isperia that the Selesnya are gathering armies.
timeline.quote: The Selesnya are gathering armies.

citation.text: Horncaller's Chant (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Boros are losing their angels to the Gateless Movement.
timeline.quote: I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement.

citation.text: Urbis Protector (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teysa Karlov drafted a non-magical new Guildpact that no guild took seriously.
timeline.quote: Since it was not backed up by metaphysical forces, no guild took it seriously.

citation.text: "Guildpact (spell)", section "Teysa's Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa's coup with Tajic against the Obzedat is foiled by her ghostly grandfather, and the Ghost Council strips her of her offices.
timeline.quote: she was foiled by her ghostly grandfather and stripped of her office of advokist and grand envoy by the Ghost Council.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Staging a coup". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The angel delivers a message from the ghost halls of the Obzedat for Teysa Karlov.
timeline.quote: I have come from the ghost halls of the Obzedat with a message for Teysa Karlov.

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The angel says Teysa Karlov must complete the maze at all costs.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov must find the correct route and complete the maze at all costs.

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Teysa completes the Implicit Maze but Lazav causes mayhem until Jace links the maze-runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and making him the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: this triggered the Supreme Verdict , which restored the Guildpact 's magic and empowered Jace as Ravnica's first Living Guildpact .

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Maze-runner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tajic scouts with a platoon, linking with Orzhov patrols that, through Teysa Karlov, helped root out Dimir sleeper cells; the Obzedat agree to shared protection of the Ninth.
timeline.quote: the Boros and Orzhov would share protection duties over the Ninth

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Teysa returns from another day of being yelled at by the Orzhov Ghost Council and reads her old mail by the fire.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov had spent another full day being yelled at by the dead.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Teysa recalls weeks earlier badgering the Living Guildpact into affirming twenty minor laws until he threw her out.
timeline.quote: After asking him to confirm no less than twenty minor laws and legal requirements

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Teysa resolves to use a loophole created by the Guildpact's new body to challenge the Obzedat's monopoly.
timeline.quote: She could manipulate this technicality to challenge the monopoly of the Obzedat.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Her ghostly grandfather Karlov appears and lectures her to think of her blood, and she is forced to kiss his ring.
timeline.quote: subserviently kissed the outline of the Councilman's gossamer ring.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Karlov offers her a coin, and Teysa uses it to buy a knife.
timeline.quote: Teysa used that coin to buy a knife.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Disguised and shackled, Teysa is led by Tajic through Orzhova to a Boros outpost prison.
timeline.quote: There was a Boros outpost prison near the edge of the main church building.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: In a basement cell Tajic reveals the secret tunnel he carved to the Obzedat's record room, and Teysa explains her law-magic plan.
timeline.quote: All I need to do is directly reference a law affirmed by him and it must be made manifest.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Teysa recites guild law to open a hidden wall with a warrant and to expose a web of security threads in the records library.
timeline.quote: Small threads appeared in the air, reflecting a web of silvery shimmers in the light of the torch.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Teysa uses her blood and an article of the Orzhovniha to open the gem-encrusted door of the Obzedat's sanctum.
timeline.quote: The blood was quickly absorbed as a lock deep within the structure released.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: They find the preserved, mummified bodies of the Obzedat on thrones, and Teysa greets her uncle's body.
timeline.quote: Hello, Uncle,

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Teysa pulls up a jeweled chest of records and finds an old Orzhov logbook that Tajic judges to be proof of financial corruption.
timeline.quote: My gut says this is probably the proof you're looking for.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Teysa invokes the law of exposure, but the logbook becomes immovable and Tajic cannot lift it.
timeline.quote: No matter how hard he tried, he could not pick it up.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Teysa discovers the Guildpact's law can be broken in the chamber when Tajic easily takes her knife.
timeline.quote: The law can be broken in this room,

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Karlov reveals himself and summons the Obzedat, who rise from the floor.
timeline.quote: Tajic yelled with surprise as dozens of ghosts swiftly rose from beneath the floor.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Karlov has a thrull take Tajic to the Obzedat dungeon.
timeline.quote: Summon a thrull to escort the Boros to our dungeon,

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: The Obzedat revoke Teysa's title of advokist and forbid her the practice of law.
timeline.quote: By order of the Obzedat, your title of advokist is hereby revoked .

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Karlov tells her to come to the tower to discuss her remaining title as Grand Envoy and leaves.
timeline.quote: Don't keep me waiting,

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Alone, Teysa realizes the title of Grand Envoy was only a way to keep her in debt, takes Tajic's sword as a cane and walks toward the stairs.
timeline.quote: The title of Grand Envoy was never a gift. It was a way to keep her bound.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Teysa Karlov declares the Orzhov reward greatness openly.
timeline.quote: "This is Orzhov, and this is how we reward greatness."

citation.text: Orzhov Guildgate (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teysa Karlov builds her estate after the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: the ostentatious estate of Teysa Karlov, built following the Phyrexian Invasion in 10,079 ZC

citation.text: "Tenth District", section "Orzhov territory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya, sent by Bolas, infiltrates the catacombs and kills Grandfather Karlov and the Obzedat, becoming the new Orzhov leader; Teysa is reinstated as leading oligarch.
timeline.quote: Kaya infiltrated the catacombs and killed Grandfather Karlov and all other members of the Obzedat.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Awaiting her time". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Teysa it is time to let the dead be dead.
timeline.quote: Time to let the dead be dead.

citation.text: Ethereal Absolution (Ravnica Allegiance Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teysa convenes a meeting of the Obzedat and Kaya ends it.
timeline.quote: Kaya ended it.

citation.text: Kaya's Wrath (Ravnica Allegiance Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaya ends a meeting of the Obzedat convened by Teysa.
timeline.quote: Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.

citation.text: Kaya's Wrath (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaya frees many people from Orzhov debts, causing Teysa to end their partnership.
timeline.quote: caused Teysa to end their partnership

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya attends the guild summit and witnesses its dissolution after the murder of Isperia.
timeline.quote: Kaya and Teysa attended the guild summit on behalf of the Orzhov, and witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya turns the tables, has Teysa arrested and offers the hierarchs a deal.
timeline.quote: She turned the tables, had Teysa arrested, and offered the hierarchs a deal

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya raises tithes from 10% to 40% after forgiving debts, causing riots, then lowers them to 18%.
timeline.quote: Kaya raised Orzhov's existing tithes from 10% to 40% to compensate for the losses caused by forgiving those debts, which quickly led to riots.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Under the influence of Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Teysa witness the guild summit's dissolution after Isperia's murder.
timeline.quote: Kaya and Teysa attended the guild summit on behalf of the Orzhov and witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia .

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Internal struggle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya turns the tables on the hierarchs, has Teysa arrested and offers them a deal.
timeline.quote: She turned the tables, had Teysa arrested, and offered the hierarchs a deal.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Internal struggle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya frees bound ghosts from debt against Teysa's warning; the hierarchs pressure Teysa to arrest her but Tomik helps Kaya, and Teysa is arrested.
timeline.quote: Teysa was then arrested.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Staging another coup". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Uncle orchestrates his own death through Melisk, who manipulates Teysa into unknowingly assassinating him; Teysa later uncovers the truth.
timeline.quote: Uncle" orchestrated his death to ascend to the Ghost Council

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa rallies local guild elements to halt Hauc's apocalyptic ambitions.
timeline.quote: Teysa uncovered the truth and rallied local guild elements to halt Hauc’s apocalyptic ambitions.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The final battle at the Cauldron destroys it; the three dragons are killed and Vitar Yescu is burned to ashes.
timeline.quote: The three dragons were killed — one in its egg, the other two in aerial combat.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Power over the Syndicate falls to Teysa and the Triumvirate while Kaya is distracted.
timeline.quote: With Kaya distracted, the actual power over the Syndicate fell to Matriarch Teysa Karlov and the Triumvirate

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: While Kaya fights the Phyrexian invasion, Teysa usurps the guild's leadership.
timeline.quote: However, while Kaya was fighting in defense of the Multiverse during the New Phyrexian Invasion , Teysa usurped the guild's leadership.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark, Teysa takes the reins as Matriarch and allies with Lazav to play her rivals against each other.
timeline.quote: Teysa was content to be the power behind the curtain.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Matriarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark, Lazav partners with Teysa Karlov to control the Orzhov, has Dovin Baan killed to blackmail Vraska, and partners with Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Lazav had Dovin Baan killed, which allowed the shapeshifter to blackmail Vraska

citation.text: "Lazav", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Etrata fights in the resistance to the New Phyrexian Invasion as one of Teysa Karlov's contacts; afterward, with Dimir seemingly destroyed, she loses her purpose and works as a free agent.
timeline.quote: Etrata fought in the resistance to the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Etrata", section "Phyrexian Invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa Karlov usurps Kaya's position as Orzhov guildmaster while Kaya defends the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Kaya retained her spark through the Desparkening

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Judith frames Rakdos for the Karlov Manor murders, imprisoning Agrus Kos who found Rakdos asleep.
timeline.quote: Judith imprisoned Kos, leaving nobody who could advocate for the demon's innocence.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Persecution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Teysa learns Phyrexian, supplies the resistance with intelligence, and claims guildmaster while Kaya is off-plane.
timeline.quote: claimed the title of guildmaster of the Orzhov.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Orzhov launch an extravagant fireworks display above Karlov Manor to open the gala.
timeline.quote: The sky over Karlov Manor danced with a dizzying array of colors, brought to life by shimmering cascades of magic.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya joins Teysa on the manor's highest balcony.
timeline.quote: Soundless as ever, Kaya stepped up next to her, stopping when she reached the rail.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Teysa reminds Kaya that she owes the Orzhov for not being on Ravnica during the invasion.
timeline.quote: You owe me this night, Kaya.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Teysa demands that Kaya obey her through the evening.
timeline.quote: So tonight, you smile when I say smile, and you bow when I say bow

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Teysa leads Kaya into the courtyard crowd of Ravnica's elite.
timeline.quote: settling one hand on the taller woman's shoulder in a proprietary fashion

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Teysa explains that Ezrim leads the Agency after the invasion and has drawn away Azorius associates.
timeline.quote: Imagine her displeasure when after the invasion, he took on leadership.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Tolsimir insists that Lazav is not dead and is planning something.
timeline.quote: It's naive to think that Lazav is dead.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.
